summary_paragraph: The patient was admitted with uncontrolled type 1 diabetes, nausea, vomiting, and worsening epigastric and right upper quadrant abdominal pain radiating to the back, following an inability to administer insulin due to lack of needles. Initial labs showed hyperglycemia with elevated lipase, consistent with acute pancreatitis on the background of chronic pancreatitis. She was managed with IV fluids, insulin therapy, and pain and nausea control while kept NPO. Her condition improved over two days with decreasing lipase, resolution of symptoms, and successful advancement to a regular diet. She was discharged home in stable condition with instructions to follow up with her primary care provider, continue her home insulin regimen, and maintain medication adherence.
